'''October 2001 tournament (Stu Doran)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament in October 2001. It is known from Stu Doran's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3018">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-04-os-goes-crazyd3018/ os-goes-crazy], DeckTech (Stu "Disco Stu" Doran, 4 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-04-os-goes-crazyd3018/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 2
